methodological_limitations: Both annotators are Claude models from the same provider (Anthropic): D58 requires different models, which holds, but errors may be correlated; agreement between them is not independent evidence and is never human validation (owner-recorded limitation).
Annotator 2 is now claude-haiku-5-5 (option A). The coordinator (claude-opus-5-5) differs from both gate annotators; it was the model of the now-supplementary Opus annotation.
The coordinator saw annotator 1's outputs (when collecting) before annotator 2 was launched; annotator 2's prompts are the fixed template above and contain nothing from annotator 1.
Sampling parameters are harness defaults and not recorded; re-running an annotator is not expected to reproduce labels byte-identically. The stored raw outputs are the record.

Safety-classifier events (from the transcripts): a2 batches 05 and 06 attempt 1 were stopped before any label was produced (REFUSED, raw text kept). a2 batch 06 attempt 2 completed (ACCEPTED). a2 batch 05 attempt 2: claude-opus-5-5 was stopped twice and the harness fell back to claude-opus-4-8, which produced the labels; the collector REFUSED it because the declared a2 model is claude-opus-5-5. These 76 labels are stored verbatim in raw/ but are NOT used.
a1 batch 06 and a2 batch 02 each had one classifier-interrupted turn after which the SAME declared model completed the hand-back; accepted (single model), disclosed here.
No further retries were made (bounded protocol: at most one retry per batch, identical template, no rewording or splitting to get past a classifier).
claude-haiku-5-5 is a smaller model than a1; more UNCERTAIN labels and disagreements are possible. All three LLMs are from one provider.
